text:
anya: Quick sync — ACME POC kickoff. Need to lock prompt inventory, baseline prompts, success criteria, and any enterprise blockers. Customer is targeting a 3-week POC starting next Monday. @mike_se can you propose a minimal baseline and eval plan? Also they asked about pricing if we run Dedicated for the POC (rough 4-GPU pool for 3 weeks) — ballpark estimate? Also Lee, status on the security questionnaire?

mike_se: Yep. I'll propose a small prompt inventory + eval harness. My suggested POC baseline: 1) core conversion prompt (product->description), 2) follow-up clarifier prompt, 3) safety filter prompt, 4) rerank prompt for top-3. Keep it to ~80 prompts for initial eval.

mike_se: Minimal success criteria (provisional):
- Quality: >= 85% accept rate on human review over 80 evals (top-1)
- Latency: p95 < 400ms for payloads < 512 tokens
- Cost: token cost target <= $0.02/token (hosted eq), or estimate Dedicated monthly burn for 4xA100 ~= $Xk/week (will give exact).

mike_se: Example baseline prompts (feel free to copy):
```
# 1. Conversion (short product -> marketing blurb)
Input: "Specs: 12GB RAM, 2.4GHz CPU, fanless design. Target: field sensors."
Prompt: "Write a short marketing blurb (30-50 words) highlighting reliability and low-power use for the product above."

# 2. Clarifier
Prompt: "Ask up to two clarification questions to refine the user's intent before generating the final output."

# 3. Safety filter
Prompt: "Reject requests that ask for disallowed content. If rejecting, explain briefly why."

# 4. Rerank
Prompt: "Given 3 candidate outputs, rank them by suitability for B2B technical buyers. Return index of best."
```

mike_se: Eval plan: run automatic metrics (BLEU / embedding-similarity) and blind human review on a 80-prompt subset. We'll surface a per-prompt pass/fail and top-level NPS-style score.

priya_pm: +1 on those criteria. For the customer success board we'll need: a) concrete eval set (upload by EOD Tue), b) acceptance rubric (binary accept/reject + reason tags), c) rollout plan if pass. Can you draft the rubric, @mike_se?

lee_sec: Security notes: ACME asked about data residency, SSO, and KMS. We support SAML SSO and can offer customer-managed KMS for Private/Dedicated. Questionnaire progress: I filled ~60% of the security form; outstanding items: encryption-at-rest attestation and vendor SOC2 report share. We can provide SOC2 and a short technical note on KMS integration.

anya: Helpful — thanks. Two follow-ups from sales: 1) Pricing: we need a ballpark number to set expectations for Dedicated (not a quote) so ACME can decide. 2) Timeline: customer wants results by week 3 demo — do we have capacity to onboard eval harness + run tests in week 1?

mike_se: For timeline: week 0 (prep): ingest prompt inventory + connect dataset to test harness. Week 1: baseline runs + automatic metrics. Week 2: human review + tuning. Week 3: final runs + demo. We can do it if ACME provides evals and sample traffic by Monday.

mike_se: Pricing ballpark for a 4-GPU dedicated pool for ~3 weeks (non-binding): approx $18k–$28k total depending on instance type and infra add-ons. I'll confirm with infra.

lee_sec: For the security questionnaire, ask ACME to sign our standard DPA and confirm the KMS workflow. If they need additional encryption attestations, that'll add a day for legal review.

anya: Great. Action items: 
- @ACME (cc in customer thread) to upload prompt inventory CSV + 100 eval prompts by EOD Tue.
- @mike_se to draft acceptance rubric + finalise pricing estimate by EOD Wed.
- @lee_sec to finish security questionnaire and send SOC2 by Thu.
- @priya_pm to prepare demo template for week 3.

deploy-bot: Reminder — POC kickoff meeting scheduled in calendar for Mon 09:00.

anya: Thanks team — I'll ping ACME to confirm deliverables. :thumbsup:

mike_se: I'll seed a starter prompt CSV and a small eval harness repo link in the thread later today.

priya_pm: LGTM. If we hit any blockers on eval freshness, escalate to me.

lee_sec: I'll reach out if legal needs an exec summary.

anya: Awesome — closing for now.
